content_sections.heading: ICAR-NBPGR Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download ICAR-NBPGR notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Other conditions: The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in interview Desirable: Post 1: Experience of wet lab work in Next generation sequencing, transcriptomics, real time PCR and routine molecular biology techniques Post 2: Knowledge of programming in linux/R/.Proficiency in using licenced and open source software for NGS data analyses

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: 3 years duration, initial engagement for one year with extension of tenure for two more years on yearly basis based on satisfactory performance

content_sections.heading: How Will ICAR-NBPGR Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Screening of documents Interview before the selection committee Document screening followed by interview before the selection committee in person

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Filled application form One passport size photograph Self-attested copies of all relevant certificates and marksheets (matriculation onwards) Original certificates Identity proof No Objection Certificate from present employer, if applicable

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICAR-NBPGR Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form as per the annexed format. Bring one passport size photograph and self-attested copies of all relevant certificates and marksheets from matriculation onwards. Produce original certificates along with an identity proof at the time of interview. Attend on 30 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Disputes will be resolved in jurisdiction of New Delhi only

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for ICAR-NBPGR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ICAR-NBPGR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for Young Professional-II.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ICAR-NBPGR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 30 November 2026. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 45 years (as on date of advertisement). Relaxation: women 5 years, SC/ST 5 years, PwD 10 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs 42,000 consolidated per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post-Graduation in agricultural Sciences/ Bioinformatics/ Biotechnology/Life Sciences/Botany/Genetics with minimum two years of experience.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in interview.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Screening of documents. Interview before the selection committee. Document screening followed by interview before the selection committee in person.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 3 years duration, initial engagement for one year with extension of tenure for two more years on yearly basis based on satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: New Delhi.
